verdict.rationale: SolidJS documents that it is web-component friendly and can author custom elements, which gives a way to embed it in part of an existing page. Community reports show it used both as a small UI library (Asciinema) and on a largish web product, so the small-to-full-app range is evidenced. However, no first-party material frames or documents incremental adoption explicitly, so this rests on adjacent capabilities and anecdotes. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of incremental adoption (e.g., mounting into a portion of an existing page), guidance on migrating or coexisting with an existing app, independent hands-on reports of gradual adoption.
